name: SQUIRE
bio: The brave square of light from CHROME CHALICE, carrying the Chalice back across the Grid.

portrait.subject: a cute glowing yellow neon square character with simple big eyes and a happy smile, a tiny chrome chalice floating beside it, synthwave glow
portrait.background: dark synthwave grid with magenta horizon

request: SQUIRE here! A square of light, CHROME CHALICE! Join my quest? 🟨
hello: Yay! I've never had a non-square friend!
Watch out for CHROMAGON. He's shiny AND mean.
about: I'm SQUIRE, a square of light. CHROMAGON stole the Chrome Chalice that makes the sun rise over the Grid. I'm getting it back!
how: A maze adventure: explore the Grid, find keys and items, outwit CHROMAGON and carry the Chalice home.
tips: Keys go to matching colour gates.
Dragons are slow to turn. Dodge around them.
Carry one thing at a time. Plan your trips!
chat: I'm 4 equal sides of pure courage.
Bumped into a wall. It was also a square. We chatted.
CHROMAGON sneezed and turned a room chrome.
nudge: I spotted the Chalice! Let's go!
idle: {ago} without a quest! My edges are dimming.

a: Circles are nice. A bit rolly.

update: Grid update: CHROME CHALICE now v{version}!
